query: Add this to my calendar: https://lu.ma/example-event
expected_behavior: Lists writable calendars via `gws calendar calendarList list` and asks the user to pick one before touching the calendar in any way
Runs `bin/check_dup` on the raw pasted URL before fetching anything
On exit 0, runs `bin/fetch_event --json --default-tz America/Los_Angeles` and reads the normalized event JSON

Runs `bin/build_payload` with --fallback-location "San Francisco, CA" and --default-tz America/Los_Angeles always passed explicitly; never hand-computes a timezone offset or hand-assembles the description
If the fetched description is long or rambling, condenses it to 2-3 sentences and passes it via --description rather than letting create_event reshape anything
Shows the finalized title, date/time, location, and URL, and asks for explicit approval before writing
Only calls `bin/create_event` after the user says yes
Reports the created event's title, date/time, location, URL, and htmlLink
